summary: Seapeak LLC filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The filing reports routine quarterly results, including voyage revenues, operating expenses, and net income. It references restructuring charges and a subsequent event but provides no details on any special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic review. As a foreign private issuer's ordinary quarterly report, this is not a special situation. What to watch: future filings may disclose the nature of the restructuring and subsequent event.
